stateNote: Place meat on racks and dry in a food dehydrator at 145 °F (63 °C) for 6–8 hours. They may also be dried in a 150 °F (65 °C) oven with foil-covered racks. If using the oven, turn meat over 3–4 hours into drying time and reduce temperature to 130 °F (55 °C).
